moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean make chart history
moments.blurb: Their collaboration 'Rein Me In' has spent an astonishing 18 non-consecutive weeks at UK Number 1, matching Frankie Laine's 1953 record for the longest-running chart-topper ever.

angles.name: Chart Record Breaker
angles.copy: 18 weeks at Number 1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' just equalled a 73-year-old record. Can they break it next week?

angles.name: Record-Equalling Track
angles.copy: History made! 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender & Olivia Dean is officially one of the longest-running UK Number 1s ever. What a run!
